dedupe_keys.name: uhpc shear database for transverse bar free ultra high performance concrete members

description: UHPC Shear Database for Transverse Bar-Free Ultra-High-Performance Concrete Members is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Dimitrios Kalliontzis, University of Houston (uh.edu). This dataset accompanies the journal paper entitled “One-Way Shear Design for Transverse Bar-Free Ultra-High-Performance Concrete Members” published by the ACI Structural Journal in 2026, DOI: 10.14359/51749307. This DesignSafe publication is intended to share an experimental database of 137 UHPC beam shear tests that included fiber but no transverse-bar reinforcement. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 2 top-level files (PDF, XLSX). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-jwh4-n381. Keywords: one-way shear, ultra-high-performance concrete, UHPC beams, shear tests, transverse bar-free, fiber properties. Published 2026-02-14. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
